title: claude tile data
description: Data for the bundled `claude` tile: one niri desktop, as a list of at most two ROWS. The tile is DATA-DRIVEN — waybar always references `claude`, and the template renders by what you send: one row → the rich single layout, two rows → the stacked dual layout with a shared shortcut gutter. Each row is either a Claude session (status indicator + folder + ↑unpushed) or an ordinary window (app icon + name); a desktop may hold one of each. Feed it as the module's `exec` stdout (JSON) or static `text`. Each property notes REAL (from the claude-status-db daemon) vs MOCK (synthesize it).

anyOf.$comment: The contract: one rows array, whatever each row is.
Legacy: a Claude-only desktop sent as sessions[].
Legacy: a single ordinary window sent as flat fields.

sessionRow.description: A Claude session on this desktop.

state.description: REAL (sessions.state). Drives this row's indicator: working=Claude mascot deep-orange, prompt=blinking '?' (and the WHOLE tile pulses if ANY row is prompt), idle=fade bar (see idle_level) + idle_ago, shell=mascot electric-cyan, empty=no indicator, just the bare shortcut (desktop has no session and no window — the producer's absent-desktop placeholder).

idle_ago.description: REAL-derived. When state=idle: time since active (e.g. '12m'), beside the bar. Keep it short.

title.description: MOCK. The session window title. Wrapped (one row) or tickered (two rows).

unpushed.description: MOCK. Unpushed commit count; shown as ↑N after the folder (hidden when 0 or idle).

appRow.description: An ordinary window on this desktop.

app_icon.description: A bundled icon name (e.g. 'code') or an absolute path to an .svg. Omitted → the generic 'app' glyph.

title.description: The window title (wrapped when it is the only row, tickered when there are two).

shortcut.description: MOCK. The niri desktop's shortcut number, shown first (big, in a shared left gutter when there are two rows).

active.description: Whether this is the focused/active niri desktop → the accent 'card'.

items.description: The desktop's rows, in display order: at most two, each a Claude session or an ordinary window, in any combination. Send what is on the desktop; the tile adapts — you never pick the layout, the data does.

sessions.description: LEGACY, still rendered. A Claude-only desktop. Equivalent to `items` where every row is a session; prefer `items`, which can also express a window (and a desktop holding one of each).

is_claude.description: LEGACY and IGNORED. The row's own shape now decides how it draws, so this flag no longer selects a layout. Harmless to keep sending; nothing reads it.

title.description: LEGACY, still rendered: the window title of the flat single-window form. A row inside `items` carries its own `title`.

app.description: LEGACY, still rendered: the app/window label of the flat single-window form.

app_icon.description: LEGACY, still rendered: the icon of the flat single-window form — a bundled name or an absolute .svg path.
